title: freshwaterecology.info — the taxa and autecology database for freshwater organisms
supports: Standardised European freshwater habitat, zonation, feeding and migration trait framework
caveat: Database synthesises literature; it is a trait framework, not Conwy occurrence evidence

title: Fish rheophily categories
supports: Definitions of rheophilic, limnophilic and eurytopic/indifferent fish
caveat: Definitions only

title: Fish-region / longitudinal-zonation categories
supports: Definitions of trout, grayling, barbel and bream zones
caveat: Definitions only; zones are ecological tendencies, not hard boundaries

title: www.freshwaterecology.info — An online tool that unifies, standardises and codifies more than 20,000 European freshwater organisms and their ecological preferences
supports: Database provenance and scope
caveat: Trait synthesis rather than primary species natural-history study

title: Abramis brama species summary
supports: Migration, habitat, diet, distribution and global status for common bream
caveat: Secondary synthesis; no proof of occurrence or origin in the Conwy

title: Anguilla anguilla species summary
supports: Catadromy, connected-water habitat, diet, distribution and global status for European eel
caveat: Secondary synthesis

title: Barbatula barbatula species summary
supports: Migration, gravel-stream habitat, diet, distribution and global status for stone loach
caveat: Secondary synthesis; cryptic diversity can complicate labels

title: Barbus barbus species summary
supports: Migration, fast gravel-river habitat, diet, distribution and global status for barbel
caveat: Secondary synthesis; no proof of Conwy occurrence

title: Cottus gobio species summary
supports: Cold stony-stream habitat and diet for the bullhead complex
caveat: Proxy only: the analysis label is Cottus perifretum, while UK conservation pages commonly retain C. gobio

title: Gasterosteus aculeatus species summary
supports: Facultative anadromy/residency, habitat, diet, distribution and global status
caveat: Secondary synthesis; highly variable population ecology

title: Oncorhynchus mykiss species summary
supports: Facultative anadromy/residency, cold-water habitat and diet for rainbow trout
caveat: Ecological proxy for a biologically incoherent harmonisation label; these data provide no evidence of a real hybrid

title: Perca flavescens species summary
supports: North American distribution and reference-species ecology for yellow perch
caveat: The local audit records one ASV/four reads under this geographically unexpected label; curated Perca review is required and no mis-hit, replacement identity or local occurrence is inferred

title: Perca fluviatilis species summary
supports: Habitat, ontogenetic diet, distribution and global status for European perch
caveat: Secondary synthesis; only three detected libraries in the harmonised matrix

title: Phoxinus phoxinus species summary
supports: Cold oxygenated stream habitat, migration, diet, distribution and global status for Eurasian minnow
caveat: Genus-level ecological proxy only; the harmonised P. ujmonensis name is documented namespace drift

title: Pungitius pungitius species summary
supports: Migration, shallow vegetated habitat, diet, distribution, status and taxonomic caveat
caveat: FishBase notes that P. pungitius has been misapplied to P. laevis in north-western Europe

title: Salmo trutta species summary
supports: Facultative anadromy/residency, cold gravel-stream habitat, ontogenetic diet, distribution and global status
caveat: Secondary synthesis; dominant local 12S haplotype is not species-diagnostic within Salmo

title: Salvelinus malma species summary
supports: Literal reference-species range and ecology for Dolly Varden
caveat: Not transferred to the analysis label because the harmonised label collapses incompatible S. umbla and S. fontinalis calls

title: Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar), Annex II species account
supports: Anadromy, clean gravel spawning habitat and Habitats Directive Annex II relevance
caveat: National conservation account; not a current Conwy stock assessment

title: Bullhead (Cottus gobio), Annex II species account
supports: Fast clear shallow hard-substrate habitat and Annex II relevance
caveat: Uses C. gobio nomenclature; apply to local Cottus perifretum only as a complex-level proxy

title: European eel CITES species account
supports: CITES Appendix II relevance for European eel
caveat: Trade/conservation status, not local abundance

title: Minimum fish sizes and catch limits
supports: Welsh regulatory page explicitly groups barbel, common bream and perch as native species
caveat: Native in the regulatory Welsh context does not establish natural occurrence in the Conwy catchment

title: Open seasons for non-migratory trout, Arctic charr, coarse fish and eels
supports: Documents Llyn Conwy among Welsh trout waters
caveat: Fishery regulation is supporting local plausibility, not molecular validation

title: Assessment accompanying non-native fish legislation
supports: Rainbow trout described as a non-native established fish in England and Wales
caveat: National status; does not validate this dataset's hybrid label

title: Climate Resilient Fisheries: strategy for migratory and freshwater fishes and fisheries of Wales 2026–2031
supports: Welsh conservation relevance of salmon, sea trout and eel
caveat: Wales-wide strategy rather than Conwy-specific condition estimate

title: Protecting Welsh fisheries in the face of climate change
supports: States all 23 principal Welsh salmon rivers are below sustainable limits and sea trout/eels are declining
caveat: Current Wales-wide statement; local severity may differ

title: Harmonised species-by-library count matrix
supports: Number of libraries with each analysis label
caveat: Detection is not occupancy and does not prove a living local population

title: Taxonomic harmonisation crosswalk
supports: Raw-to-clean label provenance
caveat: Harmonisation includes biologically problematic collapses

title: Taxonomic drift catalogue
supports: Assignment-instability and low-read flags for problematic labels
caveat: Audit interpretation; see row-level evidence in the file
